import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int x = sc.nextInt();
        int y = sc.nextInt();
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int bestA = 0, bestB = 1;
        double bestDiff = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        double exact = (double) x / y;
        
        for (int b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
            double aFloat = (double) x * b / y;
            int a = (int) Math.round(aFloat);
            for (int da = -1; da <= 1; da++) {
                int cand = a + da;
                if (cand < 0) continue;
                double diff = Math.abs((double) cand / b - exact);
                if (diff < bestDiff) {
                    bestDiff = diff;
                    bestA = cand;
                    bestB = b;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(bestA + "/" + bestB);
        sc.close();
    }
}
